question: In a certain code language, ‘BEHIND’ is written as ‘BLGJGD’. How will ‘ORANGE’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f390eb1aa5eef27c267010a8106c7b83cfbeaa1b6c945402f538a1e70a0d41b.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

**First three alphabet positional values are added +2 are shifted to last three.**

**Last three from fourth letter alphabet positional value are subtracted -2 are shifted to first three.**</p
